issues: The `game_loop` method is called recursively without a base case, which can lead to a stack overflow. This should be replaced with an event-driven approach using the `after` method.

The `move` method of the `Paddle` class does not check if the paddle is moving off-screen before updating its position. This can lead to a `TypeError` when trying to access an out-of-bounds index in the `coords` method.

The `update` method of the `Ball` class does not handle the case where the ball hits both paddles at the same time correctly. It should reset the x velocity when the ball hits either paddle and update the score accordingly.
The `game_loop` method is called repeatedly without any condition to stop it, which can lead to a busy loop. This should be replaced with an event-driven approach using the `after` method.
The `AGENT_SMOKE_TEST=1` environment variable is not handled correctly in the main block of code. It should exit the program immediately when this variable is set.
